NAME: V2X Target Spoofing
DESCRIPTION: An attacker impersonates external entities to inject malicious data into the architecture outlined in the 'WhatsApp Image 2026-09-24 at 11.50.41.jpeg' file. The attacker sends falsified navigation information and fake data regarding pedestrians. The attacker can also spoof extravehicular communication data about other vehicles.

NAME: Cockpit Sensor Spoofing
DESCRIPTION: An attacker feeds artificial visual data to the cameras located in the interior sensing infrastructure. This manipulates the systems designed to monitor the psychological state of the driver, effectively blinding the Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS).

NAME: AI Model Tampering
DESCRIPTION: An adversary gains access to the Main ECU and alters its computational files. This allows the attacker to manipulate the AI models. As a result, the ECU elaborates corrupted information for the system's output.

NAME: Dynamics Data Tampering
DESCRIPTION: An attacker intercepts the transmission from the Dynamics Electronic Control Unit to the Main ECU. The attacker maliciously alters the captured dynamics data from the vehicle, changing critical values such as speed or steering angle.

NAME: AR Spatial Transformation Tampering
DESCRIPTION: An attacker injects faults into the Main ECU's processing routines. This tampers with the body spatial transformations that generate the virtual frames.

NAME: V2X Message Repudiation
DESCRIPTION: The extravehicular communication system processes incoming map data but fails to securely log the origin of the messages. This allows a malicious actor to deny sending harmful data about other street users, such as pedestrians.

NAME: Driver State Repudiation
DESCRIPTION: The dedicated cockpit processing unit fails to reliably log anomalous events detected by the interior sensing infrastructure. This prevents auditors from proving the true psychological state of the driver was captured by the Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS).

NAME: Cockpit Camera Feed Disclosure
DESCRIPTION: An attacker breaches the dedicated cockpit processing unit. The attacker exfiltrates the sensitive camera feeds used by the Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS).

NAME: V2X Data Interception
DESCRIPTION: An eavesdropper intercepts unencrypted extravehicular communication entering the V2X Module. This exposes shared navigation information and real-time positional data of local vehicles.

NAME: AR Output DoS
DESCRIPTION: An attacker issues a flood of shutdown commands to the AR Output Device. This crashes the Picture Generation Unit. Consequently, the device stops projecting virtual light rays onto the windshield film. This disables the visualization of produced content for the Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems.

NAME: Main ECU DoS
DESCRIPTION: An attacker floods the internal network, overwhelming the Main ECU. This prevents the component from performing its required main computation and halts Augmented Reality content production.

NAME: Privilege Escalation in Main ECU
DESCRIPTION: An attacker exploits a software vulnerability in the system's main computational unit. The attacker gains administrative rights to control the AI models. The elevated access allows the attacker to intercept diagnostic signals sent to other areas.

NAME: Cockpit ECU Privilege Escalation
DESCRIPTION: An attacker escalates privileges within the Cockpit area's dedicated processing unit. This grants the attacker total control over the cameras used to monitor the psychological state of the driver, compromising the Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS).
